content: Screening for diabetic retinopathy in youth with Type 1 diabetes should involve comprehensive eye examinations. These exams are recommended to begin at the onset of puberty or at the age of 10 years, whichever occurs earlier, provided the individual has had diabetes for at least 3 to 5 years. Follow-up eye examinations should generally be conducted every two years. However, in certain cases, based on individual risk factors and hemoglobin A1C levels, extending the interval to every four years may be considered appropriate.
